system.description: When you're tracking a target, looking for anything out of the ordinary (such as a clue or a single piece of evidence) at the scene of interest, or otherwise attempting to learn something about a mystery, you can ask your GM one question about the task and get a very short, helpful answer that might be obvious to your character, but not to the player who doesn't have their character's experience. Action.
